Name: Blood Reverent
Information:
**Blood Reverent**

Consisting mostly of dark paladins and fallen adventurers who turn to Gotham’s path, the reverents act as the primary enforcers and captains of the Court of Decay. They almost never hold positions of political influence within their own ranks, as they are the muscle that the schemers and manipulators above them use to enforce their will. The reverents spend their time refining their control over undeath, and a special blessing from Gotham grants them the same resistance to death that their undead thralls possess.

traits.name: Aura of Turn Resistance
traits.description: Undead within 20 feet of the reverent have advantage on saving throws against being turned.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The reverent’s spellcasting ability is Intelligence. They can cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

spellcasting.casting_level_note: Their spells are cast as though at 3rd level, unless their base level is higher.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The reverent attacks once with its Graveborne Greatsword and twice with its Touch of Necrosis. It may replace its Graveborne Greatsword with casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

actions.name: Graveborne Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. When hit, the target must attempt a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 15 (3d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. If they fail, their hit points are also reduced by the necrotic damage they take until they complete a Long Rest.

actions.name: Touch of Necrosis
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 feet, one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dead Command (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The reverent performs one of its Blood Command options: Deathly Scream or Raise Menials.

options.name: Deathly Scream
options.description: A dark, banshee-like scream echoes around the reverent in a 20-foot-radius sphere, and also from up to four identical spheres centered on dead bodies the reverent chooses within 60 feet of itself. All non-undead targets in range who aren’t followers of Gotham must attempt a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each creature who fails by 5 points or more is also stunned until the end of their next turn.

options.name: Raise Menials
options.description: The reverent summons 1d4+1 Decaying Menials under its control in occupied spaces it can see within 30 feet of itself, which either appear in bursts of necrotic magic or dig themselves out of the grounds, walls or ceiling. Furthermore, the reverent can turn up to 1d4 non-undead corpses it can see within 60 feet into Decaying Menials as well. Using this feature while controlling previously summoned menials causes all existing menials to immediately die.
